_comment: Per-file line-coverage thresholds enforced by scripts/quality/coverage-gate.js. Rules are matched top-down; the first matching pattern wins, otherwise defaultThreshold applies. RATCHET: raise a threshold whenever tests push a file above it, never lower one without a rationale and a follow-up issue. Changed lines are always required to be 100% covered regardless of these thresholds.

rules.rationale: Placeholder constant only; fully executed when the harness loads it.
